source: T01 operator packet task and unlabelled neutral images only; nominal tooth count comes from its supplied specification. No evaluator answers or labels are used.
accessNote: During implementation review, one broad path search incidentally emitted evaluator filenames and repeated task text. No evaluator answer keys, expected labels or scores were opened or used. This replay reads only the neutral packet listed above.
evidenceScope: Replay of the built-in pixel pipeline. This file alone does not demonstrate desktop UI operation, independent accuracy or acceptance.

coordinateConvention.angle: Radians, clockwise from image +x around the selected workpiece center; sector end angles may exceed 2π at wrap-around.

circle.method: Algebraic initialization followed by geometric radial least squares.

outputSummary.reason: Visible radial tooth peaks were measured and compared with the user-supplied nominal count.

sampleCount.description: Angular bins derived from fitted radius, bounded to 360–1440 by default.

workpieceCenter.description: Center refined from actual tooth-cap support after circle residual and angular coverage checks; no nominal or bore center used.

countAgreementRequired.description: All five tested peak parameter settings must return the selected count; this is an observation, not a stability guarantee.

maxPitchVariation.description: Maximum coefficient of variation of ordinary observed peak gaps.

maxUnsupportedAngleDeg.description: Largest unsupported angular sector allowed for an interpretable radial profile.

minRootConcavityPx.description: A tooth root must lie at least this far inside the chord between adjacent observed tooth caps; convex polygon corners do not establish teeth.

minSupportedRootFraction.description: Required fraction of ordinary tooth gaps with observed inward roots.

maxRadialModulationRatio.description: Supported gear model limits radial 5–95% modulation to 35% of tip radius; deeper stars and spokes remain outside this model.

expectedTeeth.description: Nominal count is used only for missing-tooth comparison, never to select observed peaks.

smoothingWindow.description: Odd triangular smoothing window, derived from the strongest measured radial repetition.

minProminence.description: Minimum peak prominence in pixels; default uses the radial 5–95% range and a raster floor.

minPeakDistance.description: Minimum angular-bin separation; default is 0.48 of the measured repetition period.

tipCapDropPx.description: Connected radial cap midpoint represents each tooth; cap drop is 8% of radial range with a 1 px raster floor, capped at half local prominence.

tipRmsAllowancePx.description: Tip-circle RMS quality gate: 15% of measured radial modulation, with a 1 px raster floor; not a manufacturing tolerance.

limitations: Lengths are in px; no physical calibration or acceptance tolerance was supplied.
Visible teeth are prominent radial peaks of the real segmented outer boundary; hidden undercuts and 3D geometry are not measured.
Parameter agreement describes only the tested neighborhood on this raster and is not a stability guarantee.
Workpiece center is estimated from outer-boundary or observed tooth-cap support; missing material and nonuniform segmentation can bias it.
